entries.title: Genesis 35:1
segments: ¶And God said to Jacob, Arise, go up to Bethel, and dwell there, and make there an altar unto the *God that appeared unto thee when thou fleddest from the face of Esau thy brother.

entries.title: Genesis 35:2
segments: And Jacob said to his household, and to all that were with him, Put away the strange gods that are among you, and cleanse yourselves, and change your garments;

entries.title: Genesis 35:3
segments: and we will arise, and go up to Bethel; and I will make there an altar to the *God that answered me in the day of my distress, and was with me in the way that I went.

entries.title: Genesis 35:4
segments: And they gave to Jacob all the strange gods that were in their hand, and the rings that were in their ears, and Jacob hid them under the terebinth that [is] by Shechem.

entries.title: Genesis 35:5
segments: And they journeyed; and the terror of God was upon the cities that were round about them, and they did not pursue after the sons of Jacob.

entries.title: Genesis 35:6
segments: ¶And Jacob came to Luz, which is in the land of Canaan, that is, Bethel, he and all the people that were with him.

entries.title: Genesis 35:7
segments: And he built there an altar, and called the place El-beth-el; because there God had appeared to him when he fled from the face of his brother.

entries.title: Genesis 35:8
segments: And Deborah, Rebecca's nurse, died; and she was buried beneath Bethel, under the oak; and the name of it was called Allon-bachuth.

entries.title: Genesis 35:9
segments: And God appeared to Jacob again after he had come from Padan-Aram, and blessed him.

entries.title: Genesis 35:10
segments: And God said to him, Thy name is Jacob: thy name shall not henceforth be called Jacob, but Israel shall be thy name. And he called his name Israel.

entries.title: Genesis 35:11
segments: And God said to him, I am the Almighty *God: be fruitful and multiply; a nation and a company of nations shall be of thee; and kings shall come out of thy loins.

entries.title: Genesis 35:12
segments: And the land that I gave Abraham and Isaac, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed after thee will I give the land.

entries.title: Genesis 35:13
segments: And God went up from him in the place where he had talked with him.

entries.title: Genesis 35:14
segments: And Jacob set up a pillar in the place where he had talked with him, a pillar of stone, and poured on it a drink-offering, and poured oil on it.

entries.title: Genesis 35:15
segments: And Jacob called the name of the place where God had talked with him, Beth-el.

entries.title: Genesis 35:16
segments: ¶And they journeyed from Bethel. And there was yet a certain distance to come to Ephrath, when Rachel travailed in childbirth; and it went hard with her in her childbearing.

entries.title: Genesis 35:17
segments: And it came to pass when it went hard with her in her childbearing, that the midwife said to her, Fear not; for this also is a son for thee.

entries.title: Genesis 35:18
segments: And it came to pass as her soul was departing--for she died--that she called his name Benoni; but his father called him Benjamin.

entries.title: Genesis 35:19
segments: And Rachel died, and was buried on the way to Ephrath, which [is] Bethlehem.

entries.title: Genesis 35:20
segments: And Jacob erected a pillar upon her grave: that is the pillar of Rachel's grave to [this] day.

entries.title: Genesis 35:21
segments: ¶And Israel journeyed, and spread his tent on the other side of Migdal-Eder.

entries.title: Genesis 35:22
segments: And it came to pass when Israel dwelt in that land, that Reuben went and lay with Bilhah, his father's concubine; and Israel heard of it. And the sons of Jacob were twelve.

entries.title: Genesis 35:23
segments: The sons of Leah: Reuben--Jacob's firstborn--and Simeon, and Levi, and Judah, and Issachar, and Zebulun.

entries.title: Genesis 35:24
segments: The sons of Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin.

entries.title: Genesis 35:25
segments: And the sons of Bilhah, Rachel's maidservant: Dan and Naphtali.

entries.title: Genesis 35:26
segments: And the sons of Zilpah, Leah's maidservant: Gad and Asher. These are the sons of Jacob that were born to him in Padan-Aram.

entries.title: Genesis 35:27
segments: And Jacob came to Isaac his father to Mamre--to Kirjath-Arba, which is Hebron; where Abraham had sojourned, and Isaac.

entries.title: Genesis 35:28
segments: And the days of Isaac were a hundred and eighty years.

entries.title: Genesis 35:29
segments: And Isaac expired and died, and was gathered to his peoples, old and full of days. And his sons Esau and Jacob buried him.
